card.name: Linking words before cardiac treatment terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a named heart treatment or device, such as 'requiring' or 'of' before inotropic therapy or a pacemaker. It appears in label text on heart failure, heart block and low blood pressure.

modes.label: 'requiring' after a condition
modes.description: The word 'requiring' follows a cardiac condition and leads into a treatment.
modes.example: Patients with cardiogenic shock or who have decompensated heart failure<< requiring>> the use of intravenous inotropic therapy

modes.label: Commas in treatment lists
modes.description: A comma or 'and' sits inside a list of heart failure therapies.
modes.example: Initiate conventional therapy (i.e., digitalis<<,>> diuretics, inotropic agents,

modes.label: 'of' before pacemaker
modes.description: The word 'of' comes in the phrase 'in the presence of' a functioning pacemaker.
modes.example: patients with second- or third-degree AV block except in the presence<< of>> a functioning ventricular pacemaker, (
